method: Whole653lines across two files manually read; pinned bytes verified. No rendering/runtime test.
findings: SuspendRecalculationDrawing clears input/hover/layout through hooks and Inactivate before marking suspended, matching model caller order before source mutation. Cached dimmed pixels may remain but pointer-bearing layout cleared.

Ready-to-draw tests root exists/DONE/not suspended; it does not independently prove exhaustive/current disk scan. ResolveItemAtPoint also requires valid layout and client bounds, rather than testing current disk paths.

Synchronous render bitmap can reuse same-size dimmed bitmap; differently sized old bitmap released before allocation. Failed memory DC/bitmap clears cache and fills background. These are allocation fallback paths, not measured memory bounds or runtime leak proof.

Selection/hover overlays composed with cached graph into buffered frame. New root empties all graph state; selection changes invalidate overlays, geometry-affecting changes inactivate or trim hidden cache. Renderer-specific reuse decisions still need review.

Hover stores copied path/size text plus borrowed current item pointer; resets on suspension,size,newroot. HoverInfo returns view of owned pane text while visible/cursor inside. No arbitrary asynchronous lifetime guarantee.
Mouse wheel retains separate navigation/zoom partial-delta remainders, executes one command per full delta and stops if selected/zoomed item unchanged. Mode resets clear remainders.
Hardlink highlighted display maps flag to index snapshot; extensions based on model registration grouping. Neither visualization hit test nor highlight is content-equality evidence.
limits: No Windows GDI frame capture, geometry, pointer-lifetime race, DPI, cache allocation or performance runtime test.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred.
